note: Real weather for Mt. Morris, the school's town, never a student's location. The server asks Open-Meteo (no key, no student data) every refreshMinutes and maps the weather code to a kind. Each kind draws its own sky over the outdoor maps and makes some types more common in the grass: a weight in boost multiplies that type's chance in every wild table. If the lookup fails, the sky stays as it was.

clear.label: Sunny
clear.line: Sunshine in Mt. Morris means sunshine here. Ember and Meadow Checklings are basking in the grass.

cloudy.label: Cloudy
cloudy.line: Gray skies today. Cosmic and Gear Checklings like the cover.

fog.label: Foggy
fog.line: Fog is rolling through town. Shade Checklings love a foggy day.

rain.label: Rainy
rain.line: Rain in Mt. Morris, rain in the Checkaverse. Tide Checklings are splashing through the grass.

snow.label: Snowy
snow.line: Snow is falling on the Checkaverse. Tide and Cosmic Checklings are out playing in it.

storm.label: Stormy
storm.line: Thunder over town! Storm Checklings are everywhere today.
